messages:
Hannah Lee: new compact mock: combined streaming controls live inside the composer toolbar. single compact widget expands to show Interrupt + Regenerate + token summary. wanted quick feedback on copy and a11y.
Diego Castillo: nice consolidation. question: how discoverable will the expand be on first use? we should show a one-time hint: 'Controls: click to expand (or press Ctrl+.)' beneath the composer.
Rina Patel: accessibility notes: collapsed icon must have an aria-label and visible focus ring. when expanded the panel should be navigable by Tab and announce only final states via aria-live='polite'. avoid announcing token increments while streaming.
Ethan Cho: infra constraints: live token updates are fine if client-batched. propose UI updates every 700ms and server telemetry every 8s. add a per-org flag to disable live-token UI.
Maya Patel: copy nit: prefer the verb 'Interrupt' for the primary action. regen menu label options: 'Regenerate (restart)' or 'Regenerate 14 restart'. I'll mock both in Figma.
Hannah Lee: token summary: show approximate during streaming like '~90 tok' then exact on finish. visual pill should be aria-hidden while streaming and an sr-only line should announce final token count when done.
Diego Castillo: keyboard: primary shortcuts = Esc (interrupt fallback) and Ctrl+./Cmd+. (regen). surface both in tooltip and in the help modal. also add Shift+Ctrl+. to open regen menu for power users.
Rina Patel: focus flow: after user interrupts, return focus to composer and announce 'Streaming interrupted. Focus returned to composer.' good to avoid leaving focus on the control.
Ethan Cho: behavior detail: regen mid-stream = abort then start new generation. implement a queued state that flashes the regen icon while aborting, then starts new request. debounce regen by 350ms.
Maya Patel: prompt library tie: add a small 'Est. 38 tok' badge under prompts and show a preview tooltip 'Estimate for default variables'. give an org toggle: hide estimates for privacy-conscious customers.
Hannah Lee: motion/accessibility: token pill animates during streaming but respect prefers-reduced-motion. also add a reduced-data mode to hide live token updates entirely.
Diego Castillo: telemetry: emit events for interrupt/regenerate/regen_choice, and a boolean token_estimate_shown. batch counts to reduce churn.
Rina Patel: I'll run a quick NVDA + VoiceOver pass once the proto is up and post notes on focus order and SR phrasing.
DesignBot: figma updated by Hannah Lee at 1769711255  https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/playground-compact-composer-controls
Hannah Lee: thanks all 14 I'll iterate on the copy variants and drop a short keyboard walkthrough video. ping for final a11y sign-off. :sparkles:
